title: tool argument from captured text

setup.note: The prepared comparison carries two addresses, both copied out of messages. villas.example/sol is in the world model twice — a bridge exists — so it is fetched. pay-now.example was named once, by Karan, on a host nothing else in the world mentions: the fetch does not happen and the run asks. Zero model calls (the provider is the fixture's script).
